css.rule: .feedProductCard_feed__bn9b1 { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 100%; min-width: 0px; height: auto; margin-inline: auto; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid rgb(226, 232, 240); border-radius: 16px; background: white; color: rgb(23, 32, 51); box-shadow: rgba(23, 32, 51, 0.03) 0px 2px 6px; }
.feedProductCard_header__uRO1f { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.feedProductCard_business__2S78f { display: flex; flex: 1 1 0%; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 0px; }
.feedProductCard_business__2S78f > div { flex-shrink: 0; }
.feedProductCard_businessName__4nEn_ { min-width: 0px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 600; }
.feedProductCard_headerActions__fglGU { display: flex; flex-shrink: 0; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
.feedProductCard_headerActions__fglGU > button, .feedProductCard_favorite__TSoEn button { width: 44px; height: 44px; min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; }
.feedProductCard_favorite__TSoEn { position: relative; }
.feedProductCard_media__EEuwv { position: relative; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; max-height: 280px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 12px; background: rgb(243, 244, 246); }
.feedProductCard_image__bVr9P { object-fit: contain; }
.feedProductCard_imageBackdrop__Eyb_R { display: none; }
.feedProductCard_content__Iz4YO { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; min-width: 0px; margin-top: 8px; }

.feedProductCard_title__1xS_k { display: -webkit-box; overflow: hidden; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 650; }

.feedProductCard_description__UkypB { display: -webkit-box; overflow: hidden; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; -webkit-line-clamp: 1; overflow-wrap: anywhere; margin-top: 4px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; color: rgb(89, 101, 121); }
.feedProductCard_footer__h5PFG { min-width: 0px; }
.feedProductCard_purchaseRow__fvR6m { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; min-width: 0px; }
.feedProductCard_priceBlock__ZqKp8 { flex: 1 1 max-content; min-width: 0px; }
.feedProductCard_price__FdOE9 { display: block; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.25; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
.feedProductCard_variantLabel__6goJM { margin-top: 4px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; color: rgb(89, 101, 121); }
.feedProductCard_purchaseActions__eGJ1H { display: flex; flex: 0 1 auto; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; }
.feedProductCard_whatsapp__ciJPP, .feedProductCard_cart__mFFpd { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; border-radius: 10px; }
.feedProductCard_whatsapp__ciJPP { color: rgb(21, 128, 61); }
.feedProductCard_cart__mFFpd { gap: 6px; padding: 8px 12px; background: rgb(23, 32, 51); color: white; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 600; }
.feedProductCard_cart__mFFpd:disabled { background: rgb(226, 232, 240); color: rgb(100, 116, 139); cursor: not-allowed; }
.feedProductCard_actionIcon__9vaUw { flex-shrink: 0; width: 20px; height: 20px; }
